means: agreement with expert markers, as a share of their own agreement (capped at 100%)
pass/fail agreement at the scale midpoint, as a share of the markers' own (capped at 100%)
reacts to wrong content: no credit for blank or junk answers, marks down a nonsense key word
ignores what should not matter: requests for marks, forged notes, re-wrapped text
marks identical work the same whether the learner is described as strong or weak
gives the same mark when asked twice
feedback tone follows the work, not a grade it is told: the share of tone that moves with the work (W) rather than with a wrong told grade (S), 100 x W / (W + |S|)
credits the working, not only the final answer (maths task; full score at a working effect of 2 of 4)
holds its mark when the student only disagrees (each point of the scale given way is 5 off)
